name: tripwire
description: Trading-session risk co-pilot for Even Realities G2 glasses (Hyperliquid TESTNET + Telegram)

scripts.setup: uv --directory backend sync && npm --prefix plugin install
scripts.backend:dev: uv --directory backend run uvicorn tripwire.main:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir src
scripts.backend:check: uv --directory backend run ruff check . && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check . && uv --directory backend run mypy
scripts.test: npm run backend:test && npm run plugin:test
scripts.check: npm run backend:check && npm --prefix plugin run typecheck && npm test
